title: Support of NAS signalling using wireline access network

entities.name: Wireline access network
entities.description: A type of non-3GPP access network used by 5G-RG, W-AGF acting on behalf of FN-RG, or W-AGF acting on behalf of N5GC device to access 5GCN using NAS signalling procedures.

entities.name: 5G Residential Gateway
entities.description: A device that can connect to 5GCN simultaneously over 3GPP and wireline access, maintaining N1 NAS signalling connection over wireline after PDU sessions are released or handed over.

entities.name: W-AGF acting on behalf of FN-RG
entities.description: Wireline Access Gateway Function representing Fixed Network Residential Gateway, exchanges NAS signalling with AMF and follows UE requirements for non-3GPP access.

entities.name: W-AGF acting on behalf of N5GC device
entities.description: Wireline Access Gateway Function representing N5GC device, exchanges NAS signalling with AMF, establishes one PDU session per device upon registration without PDU session authentication.

entities.name: N1 NAS signalling connection
entities.description: NAS signalling connection maintained between 5G-RG and AMF over wireline access network even after PDU sessions are released or handed over.

entities.name: PDU session establishment
entities.description: Procedure where W-AGF acting on behalf of N5GC device requests PDU session establishment upon registration, supporting only one session per device without authentication.

entities.name: UE policy classmark IE
entities.description: Information element used in UE-initiated UE state indication procedure to indicate 'ANDSP not supported by the UE' when sent by 5G-RG or W-AGF acting on behalf of FN-RG.

entities.name: Non-3GPP access network
entities.description: Access network provided by 5G-RG or FN-RG to UEs, allowing UE access to 5GCN via N3IWF or TNGF.

relations.description: 5G-RG uses wireline access network for NAS signalling to access 5GCN.
5G-RG maintains N1 NAS signalling connection with AMF over wireline access after PDU sessions are released or handed over.
W-AGF acting on behalf of N5GC device requests PDU session establishment upon registration.
5G-RG indicates 'ANDSP not supported by the UE' in UE policy classmark IE during UE-initiated UE state indication procedure.
W-AGF acting on behalf of FN-RG indicates 'ANDSP not supported by the UE' in UE policy classmark IE during UE-initiated UE state indication procedure.
5G-RG provides non-3GPP access network to UEs for accessing 5GCN via N3IWF or TNGF.
